Setup instructions

Original installation instructions

  1. Codex CLI route: Read Vercel's current agent-skills README and select react-best-practices for your coding host.
  2. Give the agent one slow route and relevant source files. Request findings with code references before edits. Expect recommendations; measure any resulting performance change.
Check before keeping it

Ask for one small result, inspect the output and permissions, and confirm it suits your app. If it fails, undo your changes and return to your original project.
